It shows two separate groups of bars (effectively, two charts): the left group shows the accuracy for all four models, and the right group shows the token count for all four models. Each model is represented by only one bar within each group, not two sets of bars.

The metrics are differentiated by their position in two separate groups of bars, each with its own title and y-axis.
